categories.label: Fragrance & Attar
categories.tagline: Oud, musk and amber — bottled by hand
categories.blurb: Alcohol-free attar oils, roll-on perfume, body mists and bakhoor sourced for depth and longevity.

categories.label: Skincare & Beauty
categories.blurb: Sunscreen, serums, moisturiser and lip colour chosen for Bangladeshi weather and skin tones.

categories.label: Hair Care & Accessories
categories.blurb: Silk scrunchies, satin bonnets, claw clips and heatless styling sets that protect your hair.

categories.label: Fashion & Lifestyle
categories.blurb: Anti-tarnish jewellery, canvas totes, mini purses and card holders built to last past one season.

categories.label: Accessories & Gift
categories.blurb: Curated gift boxes, jewellery, makeup tools and organisers — including Under ৳499 and Under ৳999 sets.

combos.title: Royal Attar Box
combos.description: Our signature presentation box holding premium attar in miniature glass bottles — choose the 3-flavour or 5-flavour set. Includes Cambodian Oud, White Musk and Amber Noir as standard; the 5-flavour set adds Royal Rose and Sandal Wood. Each bottle is alcohol-free, long-lasting perfume oil, sealed with a glass dipper and presented on a maroon velvet tray inside a rigid ivory box.

combos.title: Couple Box
combos.description: One gents attar and one ladies roll-on perfume oil, paired in a single gift box. The gents side carries a warm oud-and-amber blend; the ladies side is a soft alcohol-free floral musk roll-on that sits close to the skin. Finished with a handwritten card slot — the most requested anniversary and wedding gift we stock.

combos.title: Daily Glow Combo
combos.description: A three-step everyday routine in one box: Korean SPF 50+ sunscreen, a buildable lip tint, and a pure silk scrunchie. Built for the daily commute — sun protection, a wash of colour, and a hair tie that does not crease. Comes in a slim ivory box that fits a tote.

products.title: Cambodian Oud Attar
products.description: A deep, resinous Cambodian oud with a smoky opening that settles into warm woods and a faint sweetness. Alcohol-free perfume oil, so a single dab on the wrist lasts through the day and into evening prayers. Supplied in a glass roll-top bottle with dipper.

products.title: White Musk Attar
products.description: Clean, powdery white musk — the safest choice if you are new to attar. Soft enough for the office, warm enough for Jummah. Alcohol-free oil that sits close to the skin and never turns sharp.

products.title: Amber Noir Attar
products.description: Golden amber over vanilla and a dry tobacco base. Sweet but not cloying, and the projection is generous — best used sparingly in the warmer months. Alcohol-free perfume oil in a faceted glass bottle.

products.title: Rose Musk Roll-On Perfume Oil
products.description: Alcohol-free roll-on perfume oil built around Taif rose softened with white musk. The steel rollerball glides cold on the skin and the scent stays a quiet arm's-length halo rather than filling a room. Handbag-sized.

products.title: Jasmine Oud Roll-On Perfume Oil
products.description: Night-blooming jasmine laid over a light oud base — floral at first, quietly woody after an hour. Alcohol-free roll-on, so it is gentle on sensitive skin and safe to reapply.

products.title: Velvet Body Mist
products.description: A fine-spray body mist in soft peony and vanilla, light enough to layer over attar or wear alone after a shower. 250 ml bottle with a locking collar so it will not leak in a bag.

products.title: Oud Room & Car Freshener Spray
products.description: Concentrated oud-and-amber air spray for rooms, wardrobes and car interiors. Two pumps hold for hours, and the formula is water-based so it will not stain upholstery. Comes with a hanging felt tag you can spray for a slow release.

products.title: Bakhoor & Burner Set
products.description: A ceramic electric burner paired with 40 g of hand-rolled bakhoor chips in oud and saffron. No charcoal and no smoke alarm — the plate warms the chips gently so the scent fills the room in minutes. Ideal for Thursday evenings and guest arrivals.

products.title: Korean Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++
products.description: A lightweight chemical sunscreen that finishes matte with no white cast — tested through Dhaka humidity. SPF 50+ PA++++ with niacinamide and panthenol, so it doubles as the last step of a morning routine. 50 ml tube.

products.title: Glowing Face Serum — 10% Vitamin C
products.description: A stabilised 10% vitamin C serum with ferulic acid for brightness and even tone. Thin, fast-absorbing, and low enough in concentration to use daily without stinging. Amber glass dropper bottle keeps it from oxidising. 30 ml.

products.title: Ceramide Barrier Moisturiser
products.description: A gel-cream with ceramides and hyaluronic acid that hydrates without the heavy film. Sits well under sunscreen and makeup, and calms the tightness that follows a strong cleanser. Fragrance-free. 50 ml jar.

products.title: Glossy Lip Oil
products.description: A non-sticky lip oil in a sheer wash of colour, with jojoba and vitamin E for overnight repair. The doe-foot applicator carries just enough product, and the finish is glass-glossy rather than tacky.

products.title: Velvet Matte Lipstick
products.description: Full-coverage matte in one pass, with a soft powder finish that does not crack over dry lips. Transfer-resistant enough for a mask, and the bullet is wide enough to line the lip without a pencil.

products.title: Water Lip Tint
products.description: A watery Korean-style tint that stains rather than coats — the colour stays after tea and the lips still feel bare. Build it up for a full lip or blot it once for a just-bitten wash.

products.title: Face Sheet Mask Set — 10 Pieces
products.description: Ten single-use sheet masks across five varieties: hyaluronic acid, green tea, rice, centella and vitamin C. Cotton-cupra sheets hold serum without sliding off. Keep a few in the fridge for the hot months.

products.title: Pure Silk Scrunchie Set — 3 Pieces
products.description: Three 100% mulberry silk scrunchies in ivory, maroon and charcoal. Silk slides against the hair instead of gripping it, so you avoid the dent and the breakage a rubber band leaves. Hand-stitched elastic casing.

products.title: Satin Sleep Bonnet
products.description: A double-layer satin bonnet with a wide soft-elastic band that stays on through the night without pressing a line into your forehead. Keeps a blow-dry and reduces morning frizz. One size, adjustable.

products.title: Trendy Claw Clips — Pair
products.description: Two large matte claw clips with a strong steel spring — they actually hold thick hair up through a working day. Marbled acetate finish in tortoise and ivory, no visible seam lines.

products.title: Mini Straightener & Heatless Curler Set
products.description: A travel-size ceramic mini straightener paired with a satin heatless curling rod. Use the rod overnight for soft curls with no heat damage, and the straightener for edges and fringe touch-ups. Dual voltage, with a heat-safe pouch.

products.title: Anti-Tarnish Ring Set — 4 Pieces
products.description: Four stacking rings in 18k-gold-plated stainless steel — a plain band, a twisted band, a pearl solitaire and a fine cubic zirconia eternity. Anti-tarnish and water-safe, so they survive wudu and washing up without going green.

products.title: Anti-Tarnish Chain Bracelet
products.description: A fine flat-link chain bracelet in gold-plated stainless steel with a lobster clasp and a 2 cm extender. Anti-tarnish, hypoallergenic, and light enough to layer under a watch.

products.title: Pearl Drop Earrings
products.description: Freshwater pearl drops on a gold-plated hook with a silicone stopper so they sit forward rather than slumping. Understated enough for work, bright enough for a wedding.

products.title: Oxidised Jhumka Earrings
products.description: Classic oxidised-silver-finish jhumka with a bead fringe and a light hollow dome — full-looking without dragging on the earlobe. Pairs with both a saree and a kurti.

products.title: Layered Pendant Necklace
products.description: A two-strand necklace — a short cable chain with a tiny cubic zirconia pendant over a longer plain chain — pre-linked so the layers never tangle. Gold-plated anti-tarnish steel.

products.title: Anti-Tarnish Anklet — Pair
products.description: A pair of fine anklets with small bell charms in anti-tarnish gold-plated steel. Adjustable clasp fits most ankles, and the charms are soft enough not to jingle loudly.

products.title: Heavy Canvas Tote Bag
products.description: A 12 oz cotton canvas tote with reinforced shoulder straps, an inner zip pocket and a flat base that lets it stand up on its own. Fits a 14-inch laptop, a water bottle and a tiffin box. Machine washable.

products.title: Mini Purse & Card Holder
products.description: A slim vegan-leather card holder with six card slots, a note sleeve and a snap coin pouch — sized to slip into the front pocket of a tote. Stitched edges, no raw lining.

products.title: Polarised Sunglasses
products.description: UV400 polarised lenses in a lightweight acetate frame with spring hinges. Cuts road and water glare properly rather than just darkening. Supplied with a hard case and a microfibre cloth.

products.title: Minimal Fashion Watch
products.description: A 34 mm slim quartz watch with an ivory sunray dial, thin baton markers and a mesh steel strap that adjusts without tools. 3 ATM water resistant — safe in rain, not for swimming.

products.title: Mini Crossbody Bag
products.description: A structured mini crossbody in quilted vegan leather with a detachable chain-and-strap combination, so it works as a shoulder bag or a clutch. Fits a phone, a lipstick and a card holder.

products.title: Slim Bifold Wallet
products.description: A genuine-grain bifold with eight card slots, two note compartments and an RFID-blocking lining. Slim enough for a back pocket without the bulge.

products.title: Quilted Makeup Pouch
products.description: A quilted satin pouch with a wipe-clean waterproof lining and a wide chunky zip that opens flat so you can actually see what is inside. Holds a full daily kit.

products.title: Makeup Brush Set — 12 Pieces
products.description: Twelve synthetic-bristle brushes covering face and eye, with tapered ferrules and matte handles. Synthetic fibres pick up less product and wash clean in one go. Includes a standing holder.

products.title: Beauty Blender Set — 4 Pieces
products.description: Four latex-free sponges — teardrop, flat-edge, mini and powder-puff — plus a vented drying case. The flat edge is the one that finally gets foundation under the eyes without streaking.

products.title: Acrylic Makeup Organizer
products.description: A clear acrylic organiser with a brush well, four lipstick tiers and a deep drawer on smooth runners. Heavy enough not to skid across a dressing table when you pull the drawer.

products.title: Cosmetic Travel Bag
products.description: A hanging travel case with four zip compartments, a removable brush roll and a swivel hook for the back of a bathroom door. Folds down to the size of a paperback.

products.title: Nail Care Set — 10 Tools
products.description: Ten stainless-steel grooming tools — clippers, scissors, cuticle pusher, tweezers, file and more — in a snap-shut leatherette case. Mirror-polished so they do not rust in a humid bathroom.

products.title: Facial Ice Roller
products.description: A gel-filled stainless roller you keep in the freezer — rolls out morning puffiness and calms heat rash in about a minute. Sealed head, no leaking, with a stand.

products.title: Rose Quartz Gua Sha & Roller
products.description: Genuine rose quartz gua sha stone and a double-ended face roller, both hand-finished so the edges glide instead of dragging. Use with a few drops of serum along the jaw and brow.

products.title: Engraved Compact Mirror
products.description: A double-sided compact — plain and 2x magnifying — in a brushed metal shell with an engraved border. Snaps shut firmly so it will not open inside a bag.

products.title: Jewellery Organizer Gift Box
products.description: A velvet-lined two-tier box with ring rolls, a necklace hook panel and a small mirror in the lid. Presentable enough to give as the gift itself.

products.title: Couple Bracelet & Keychain Set
products.description: A matched pair — two anti-tarnish steel bracelets and two interlocking keychain halves, packed in a slim magnetic box with a blank card. The most-bought anniversary gift under ৳700.

products.title: Gift Box Under ৳499
products.description: A ready-wrapped box on a strict budget that still looks considered: one roll-on perfume oil, one silk scrunchie and one compact mirror, on a maroon tray with a blank card. Nothing in it feels like filler.

products.title: Gift Box Under ৳999
products.description: A fuller box at under a thousand: one attar, one water lip tint, a silk scrunchie and a pearl-drop earring pair, on a velvet tray with a ribbon and card. Our standard birthday answer.

products.title: Eid Gift Box
products.description: Built for Eid: a gents attar, bakhoor chips, a pair of oxidised jhumka and a dates-and-chocolate tin, packed in a deep maroon rigid box with a foiled crescent card.

products.title: Valentine Gift Box
products.description: A rose-musk roll-on, a glossy lip oil, a couple keychain pair and a dried-rose sachet in a heart-embossed box. Shipped with the price slip removed on request.

products.title: Anniversary Gift Box
products.description: One gents attar, one ladies roll-on, a layered pendant necklace and a pair of anti-tarnish bracelets — a two-person box rather than a single gift. Velvet tray, magnetic lid, blank card.

products.title: Self-Care Gift Box
products.description: A quiet-evening box: sheet masks, a facial ice roller, the ceramide moisturiser, a satin bonnet and a body mist. For the friend who keeps looking after everyone else.

products.title: Customizable Gift Box
products.description: Pick the box size, then message us on WhatsApp with the items you want inside and the name for the card — we assemble, wrap and photograph it before dispatch so you can approve it. Price shown is the box and wrapping; item costs are added to the invoice.
